overall_summary: Husband-wife relationship dynamics consistently outperform all other topics by an order of magnitude (1,600+ views vs <400 average). Generic Shayari and preachy advice underperform.

winning_patterns.evidence: Top 2 videos ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar...' - 1770 views, 'पत्नी की ये बात...' - 1679 views) generated over 70% of total channel views.
winning_patterns.action: Focus core content strategy around subtle everyday marital emotional friction, quiet care, and realistic long-term relationship realization.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic Sad Shayari & Preachy Moral Lessons
weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा...' got 21 views; preachy/parenting videos stay under 200 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic phrasing and lecture-style advice; replace with specific, observable real-life moments.

next_video.concept: A wife quietely serving tea to her husband who is glued to his phone screen.
next_video.opening_direction: Show a cup of tea being placed on the table next to a husband scrolling on his phone without looking up.
next_video.twist_direction: The voiceover reflects on how two people can sit in the same quiet room for hours, missing the silence they used to share.
next_video.reason: Leverages the proven high-performing theme of marital dynamics, using a specific visual slice-of-life hook rather than generic quotes.

experiment: Testing whether slice-of-life domestic scenarios sustain the higher view baseline of husband-wife content compared to text/podcast formats.
